ns2:section.sectionText: Introduction to railway vehicle technology. The railway and the environment: energy consumption, air pollutions, external noise, external vibrations. Railway traffic development and future. Rail vehicles - technical basis. Aerodynamics and running resistance. Running gear, bogies and car body tilting. Traction technology: traction motors, transmission, traction mechanics and current collection. Braking technology. Car bodies. Passenger environment, interior design and auxiliary power. Internal noise, internal vibrations and climate resistance. Rail vehicle market and development. Note: The material in this course has been developed by KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Sweden. UIUC students will be enrolled as online students in KTH course SD 2307 Rail Vehicle Technology to view lecture material.
